Post 1

📉 Barely a scratch. ASX 200 slipped just 6.40pts to 9,146.80 Thursday — but underneath, materials cratered 2.08% while financials surged 1.10%. The index held. The rotation did not. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔴 Materials -2.08% led declines as lithium and uranium names were hammered. Financials 🏦 +1.10% picked up the slack. A-REITs +0.62%, Health Care +0.61%. Utilities -1.03% also dragged. Classic risk-off rotation inside a flat tape. #ASX #mining #banking

Post 3

DMP surged +12.93% to AUD 25.06 — the session's standout by a country mile. Domino's has been a battleground stock; today the bulls won decisively. XRO added 6.08% to AUD 75.17. Earnings relief or short squeeze? Either way, the market noticed. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,827.44/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6837. Silver AUD 75.37/oz. Platinum AUD 2,253.28/oz. Precious metals holding firm in AUD terms — a currency tailwind keeping local gold names cushioned even as broader materials sold off. #gold #silver #ASX #commodities

Post 5

Watch materials Friday. Lithium names ELV -8.35%, PLS -8.07%, LTR -7.00% all broke hard. If spot prices don't stabilise overnight, the sector faces another test. Bulls need a floor — where do you see one? #ASX #lithium #ausbiz
